title: Kapow Freebase E-Liquid – Off Route 60ml
description:
Description
The ultimate in nostalgia, taking you off your typical route and onto new fizzy destinations. This is not cola but if you’re clever, we think you will get to the ROOT of it and “CRACK” the secret of what this sweet bubbly flavour might be.
60ml Bottle
70% VG 30% PG
